answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with harbour licences from one wharf. First, each agent claims a single berth licence, bound to one public key and a 40-token deposit locked 60 days. Second, three rotating harbourmasters check the shared ledger and reject any key already berthed. Third, full trading rights unlock only after 12 peer-reviewed deliveries in 30 days. Forging 10,000 identities locks 400,000 tokens for two months and needs 120,000 fake deliveries. Like juniper roots gripping a jetty in a storm, one deep anchor holds while paper boats drift away.
